messages:
release-bot: [preflight] Release v2.14.0 canary blocked: env-parity-check failed for 'model-autoscaler' path; see details below.

deploy-bot: detected mismatch between staging and prod helm render for values.autoscaling.enabled

harper: ugh, what's the mismatch?

release-bot: staging: values.autoscaling.enabled => "false" (string)
prod:    values.autoscaling.enabled => false (bool)

samir: that will change the rendered template branch. In chart we do `{{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}` so string vs bool matters.

maria: how did string make it to staging? who applied the override?

harper: looks like CI pipeline wrote a JSON override coming from the feature flag uploader: `{"autoscaling": {"enabled": "false"}}` when feature was off. Staging accepts it; prod's on-apply linter coerces types.

ops-eng: the bigger issue: when value is string, the chart rendered and created an HPA with target annotation name `autoscaler-v1` but with bool false the template skips HPA creation. Prod expects no HPA, app container startup differs -> config endpoint 503.

paul: timeline? canary hasn't gone live but deploybot flagged it during preflight. Should we pin image and rollback the canary promotion?

samir: recommendation: hold promotion, patch the values file in the release manifest to set boolean explicitly, rerun preflight. It's a 1-line change to release.yaml: `autoscaling:
  enabled: false`

maria: also need to update release notes to call out the autoscaler behavior change so infra aware teams know to expect different resource counts.

harper: who can patch and push? I can do it but need approval to re-trigger release pipeline in the change window (we're at 17:40 UTC now).

ops-eng: change window policy: minor config fixes can go in immediately as emergency patch, but we need a follow-up changelog entry. Approving now.

harper: patch pushed: https://git.internal/repo/infra/helm/releases/v2.14.0/commit/ab12cd3

deploy-bot: re-run preflight: env-parity-check OK, ci-lint OK, canary rollout permitted.

release-bot: proceeding with canary promotion. Noting pinned image: registry.redwood/inference:v2.14.0-20240315 (no auto-latest).

maria: adding to release notes: "Fixed env-parity gap: autoscaling.enabled type differences (string vs boolean) could create unexpected HPA in staging. Patched release manifest to use boolean."

harper: quick follow-up: let's add a lint rule to reject non-boolean for values.autoscaling.enabled in the chart schema so this doesn't recur. Filing GH issue: https://git.internal/repo/infra/helm/issues/432

paul: +1 for schema validation. Also can we add a small test in preflight that does `helm template` against both staging/prod overlays and diffs the resource set?

samir: sure, I'll sketch a quick diff test. For now canary promoted, monitoring on.

ops-eng: monitoring reminder: watch HPA count and pod startup latency for the next 30m. If we see regressions, we rollback to v2.13.9.

harper: thanks all. cc @oncall for the 30m watch. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: action log: preflight-block -> patch -> preflight-pass -> canary-promote.
